title.narrative: Supporting Nigeria#s Staple Crop Processing Zones (SCPZs)

description.narrative: The Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (FMARD) of Nigeria called a working session at URO Nigeria on 05 November to present a Government initiative to develop Staple Crop Processing Zones (SCPZs). UNIDO was requested to lead the formulation of a Master Plan for the SCPZ programme. Specific services required from UNIDO include: - Provision of technical knowledge on the development of agro processing industrial zones; - Provision of success stories and lessons learned from relevant experience from other countries; - Management of a team of external experts to gather data/information for the Master Plan in a short period of time; and - Formulation of the Master plan through coordination with various stakeholders including government officials, international development agencies, agro value chain actors, state governments and private investors etc.
